patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts frequently pair large images with adjacent text blocks, often with the text aligned to the top or bottom of the image rather than centered.
Prominent, vertically oriented, uppercase sans-serif text is used as a distinctive section title or divider, contrasting with the elegant serif hero title.
The site uses a sophisticated palette of deep blues, dark browns, and off-whites, punctuated by rich, earthy tones in photography and occasional accent sections.

As the user scrolls, the large hero text fades out, and the background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect. Main section titles, displayed vertically, animate into view as their sections become visible.
Content sections are often introduced by a single, bold, vertically stacked word acting as a thematic header, such as 'SAVOUR' or 'DESIGN'.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large, elegant text overlay that fades out as the user scrolls, while the background image behind it parallaxes gently. A initially transparent navigation bar transforms into a sticky header with a solid, dark background upon scroll. Throughout the page, key content sections are introduced by large, vertically oriented text elements that animate into view using CSS keyframes, often with a subtle slide or fade effect as they enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: An oversized, elegant serif font for the hero title (~4x body) contrasts with large, uppercase sans-serif section titles (~2x body) and legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant across most elements, with very subtle rounding on some image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy spacing is used between major sections, creating a sense of spaciousness, while product grids maintain a denser, organized layout.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated blend of moody, high-contrast photography with elegant serif typography for the main brand, juxtaposed against bold, vertically oriented sans-serif section titles. The use of deep, rich color blocks and asymmetrical layouts creates an editorial, almost magazine-like feel that elevates the content beyond a typical marketing site.
